cohort: 247 women with disabilities and 324 age-matched controls (without disabilities) aged 15-45 years in two districts in South India (Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka).
finding: Women with disabilities had a significantly lower proportion of pregnancies compared to women without disabilities, and higher odds of diabetes and depression, but there were no significant differences in antenatal care utilization or pregnancy outcomes.
followup_time: Outcomes of any pregnancy experienced in the past two years were assessed.
